Viśeṣāviśeṣaliṅgamātrāliṅgāni guṇaparvāṇi /II.19/
Viśeṣa-aviśeṣa-liṅga-mātra-aliṅgāni guṇa-parvāṇi /II.19/

 « Particularisés, non particularisés, seulement marqués, non marqués : c'est ainsi
que s'articulent
1184 les constituants premiers [de la substance]. »

1. Dṛśyānāṃ tu guṇānāṃ svarūpa-bheda-avadhāraṇa-artham idam ārabhyate-- Viśeṣa-
aviśeṣa-liṅga-mātra-aliṅgāni guṇa-parvāṇi / Tatra–ākāśa-vāyv-agny-udaka-bhūmayo
bhūtāni śabda-sparśa-rūpa-rasa-gandha-tanmātrāṇām aviśeṣāṇām viśeṣāḥ / Tathā śrotra-
tvak-cakṣur-jihvā-ghrāṇāni buddhi-indriyāṇi / Vāk-pāṇi-pāda-pāyu-upasthāni karma-
indriyāṇi / Ekādaśaṃ manaḥ sarva-artham ity
